libmad 0.15.1b (Underbit Technologies) from the [PicoCalc YAHAL port](https://github.com/cuu/YAHAL/tree/4a27a8ba78418707681466c23bc10186e3aebeb6/lib/MAD). The source carries GPL-2.0-or-later notices and COPYING.

The optional MK61_MAD_APP build in frame.c, layer3.c, synth.c and synth.h limits the build to Layer III, accepts caller-owned scratch, stores 16-bit PCM directly and uses half-rate MPEG-1 synthesis, and uses the exact packed requantization table generated by tools/apps/mp3/pack_requant.py. Other builds keep upstream behavior.

The mirrored synthesis taps in synth.c use an in-row base pointer to preserve the original coefficient indexes without forming a pointer before the row.
